market_news.snippet: **media[1301987]**USHP (U.S. Home Price) is the first-of-its-kind liquid index product tracking U.S. home prices, backed by housing-related reserve assets, with USHPi (U.S. Home Price - Income) available as its income-bearing variantUSHP has received institutional commitments up to $100 million, anchored by the Galaxy Sharplink Onchain Yield Fund, Forward Industries (Nasdaq: FWDI) and othersUSHP will be issued by USHP Limited, a British Virgin Islands company and subsidiary of the USHP Foundation, a Cayman Islands foundation company, with Index Industries serving as technology and services providerUSHP will be made available only to eligible institutional and non-U.S. investors GEORGE TOWN, Cayman Islands, Nov. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The USHP Foundation, a Cayman Islands foundation company, today announced the upcoming launch of USHP, the first tokenized liquid index product tracking U.S. home prices. USHP gives investors broad, diversified exposure to U.S. housing through a single financial instrument. market_news.snippet: In a significant move, KKR, Singtel, and Tata Communications are gearing up to offload STT Global Data Centres India, anticipating a valuation that could surpass $5.5 billion.
